messages.text: BL-1836 🎵 in progress — At its hard deadline the closing ceremony composes the headless git-log briefing and commits it, so the documenter finds a briefing on main and writes none - every morning email from 2026-09-23 was that dump; the human ruled to wait for the documenter and, if it has not finished when the swarm must be down, stop without a dump and let it write after the restart - the ceremony lands the documenter's briefing the moment it exists, ends when the day is recorded as sent in the ledger's own {"sent": [...]} shape (it read a bare list and never matched), and never writes a briefing itself
